tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od zer mtha' yas bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma ri tsyai/ rab 'byams 'phrin las 'od zer gyis/ /'gro la re ba'i 'bras stsol ma/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can btud nas/ /'phags ma de yi sbyin sreg bshad/ /lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang / nad dang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i don du/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs dben par/ thab khung dkar po/ rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed/ kha khyer sor bzhi bskyed nas/ sor bzhi'i dpangs su brtsigs pa'am bris pa'i mu ran la/ rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la mya ngan med pa'i shing bri bar bya'o/ /der dri zhim zhing kha dog dkar po'i bud shing ngam/ yang na srog chags med pa'i lci ba gtsang mas brtsigs pa'i g.yas su/ yam shing / mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams rim pa bzhin dgos pa ni/ bsreg rdzas dang / g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / dkar gtor gnyis bsham mo/ /de nas rang nyid shar phyogs te 'dug pa'i mdun du/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ dgang blugs/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang / dri'i chu bzhag go /sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi la mchod pa/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ gaṇḍe ra ṇis byin rlabs/ bdag dang 'gro ba nas/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/bar spyi 'gre grangs ci rigs/ bla ma dang / sogs kyang spyi 'gre/ sems can thams cad/ sogs kyang spyi 'gre la/ rje btsun 'od zer can ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang / sogs tshad med bzhi spyi 'gre/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs gong bzhin/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po'i bum pa'i nang du/ paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa maṃ las mya ngan med pa'i shing maṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du maṃ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/

oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa ya/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar 'gre/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā mā rī tsyai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags sbyar ba gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur brgyan/ snying gi nang gi maṃ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ byin gyis rlob par gyur/ oṃ ma ri tsyai maṃ swāhā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu ste de snyed bzlas na las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /gzhan yang / tadya thā/ oṃ pa rā kra ma si/ pa rā kra ma si/ u da ya ma si/ nai ra ma si/ arkaka ma si/ markaka ma si/ urma ma si/ ba na ma si/ gul ma ma si tsī ba ra ma si/ ma hā tsī ba ra ma si/ oṃ tar dha na ma si swāhā/ rtsa sngags dang / tadya thā/ oṃ brtā li/ ba rā li/ ba rā li/ ba rā ha mu khi sarb+ba duṣṭa naṃ pra duṣṭa naṃ/ tsakṣur mu khaṃ bhandha bhandha bandha mu khaṃ dzambha ya stambha ya mo ha ya swāhā/ oṃ mā rī tsyai swāhā/ oṃ ba ra le/ ba da le brtā li ba rā ha mu khi sarb+ba duṣṭa/ pra duṣṭa naṃ tsakṣur mu khaṃ bandha bandha swāhā/ snying po sngags dang / na mo ratna tra yā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ ā lo tā lo ka los satstsha lo sarb+ba murti rakṣa rakṣa maṃ swāhā/ las sngags 'di rnams kyang ci nus bzlas la/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ badzra sa twa sogs yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa/ shlau ka gcig oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs zhes brjod/ bdag bskyed do/ /bsangs chu la dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/ thab dang bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas rnams la dri'i chus gtor zhing / oṃ a mṛ tas ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che dkar po las grub pa'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan par bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐/ zhes lan gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ mchod sngags gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin phyag rgya bcas/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi mi dgos/ bsreg rdzas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phreng skor sogs bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ spor lde thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la raṃ/ lan gsum gyis thab la g.yas bskor byas la me sbar/ sngags de nyid kyis/ mar dgang blug gsum bud shing gi khar g.yas bskor du blugs/ dri'i chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs zhing / swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa zhu ba las/ me lha dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ra skyes dmar po la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa dbyu gu gsum pa/ g.yon pas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang /

mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ zhi zhing dul ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ rang gi snying gi maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya las g.yab pa'i tshul du bya zhing / oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong 'byung po'i bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs la thab kyi shar lhor bzhugs pa la/ oṃ agna ye padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis padma'i gdan phul/ oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin/ shapta 'di bzhin rigs 'gre/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi rol chen/ me lha'i lce'i rtse mor rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi raṃ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ agne ye dī pya dī pya bi shuddha ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i rgyab ri seng ge'i mgo bo lta bu'i mig g.yon mtshon pa'i brag ri zhig pa'i pra rtags ngan pa sogs 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul lo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ me lha dam tshig pa la bstim par bsam zhing / oṃ e hye hi agna ye sa pā ri wā ra badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /phyag rgya rnams kun rig bzhin/ yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ bdag bskyed kyi dbang lha'i skabs ltar mchod/

gsol gdab dbang bskur rgyas 'debs rnams kyang bdag bskyed bzhin la/ 'di la dbang bskur ba zer ba tsam khyad par ro/ /ku sha bsang sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed de/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin/ /zhes dang / oṃ agne ye/ ri pra ngan pa sogs bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thabs kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad nas 'bul lo/ /mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams gong du brjod pa'i tshul gyis phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po khro bos dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mong thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ agna ye/ gdan sa sogs spel tshig gong bzhin bcas tshar gcig oṃ agna ye swāhā/ lnga/ yang gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig bcas khyon bdun/ de bzhin mar nas ku sha'i bar la'ang thog mthar spel tshig sbyar/ bar pa lnga la mar sbyar ba kho na las rdzas so so'i sngags brjod mi dgos so/ /slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas/ /gdan sa sogs nas/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ mar gyi blugs gzar gcig blugs pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i mer gyur par blta'o/ /'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /me 'bar ba'i dbus su bhrūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ maṃ las zhes sogs nas/ gyur pa las bar yang gong bzhin/

lha mo 'od zer can ma nas/ hūm̐ sngon po bar yang gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi mā ri tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa ya/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol chen/ rdor 'dzin/ dril gsil bcas/ gang gi sogs bstod pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i shlau ka dang pos bstod/ dgug gzhug dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod pa/ gsol 'debs/ dbang bskur/ rgyas 'debs rnams bdag bskyed bzhin la/ 'di la dbang bskur ba zer ba tsam khyad par ro/ /rje btsun 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / chos skyong dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ snga ma ltar byon zan dbul bar bsam zhing / oṃ mā rī tsyai agna ye swāhā/ zhes bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byon zan dbul lo/ /de nas/ oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi satwa ya/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar phyi'i mchod pas mchod la/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol chen/ rdor 'dzin/ dril gsil gyis/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang / /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing / /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad ma/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir/ /padma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa/

/bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing / /g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dgyes dgur spyod/ /bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis/ /rnam par brgyan pas chos tshul kun sgrogs shing / /sngags tshul du mas dngos grub kun stsol ba/ /chos sngags yi ger 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi yang / /mkhyen dang brtse bas kun nas rab rtsen zhing / /gdul bya'i yid la sna tshogs kun 'jug pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyi/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / /srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /de nas yam shing thogs la/ oṃ mā rī tsyai/ gdan sa sogs nas/ shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bar gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig dang / oṃ mā rī tsyai swāhā/ dgu/ yang gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig bcas bcu gcig gam/ yang na brgya tshar sogs la'ang thog mthar spel tshig bar na grangs gang yod la sngags kho na'o/ /de bzhin mar nas ku sha'i bar rigs 'gre/ bsreg rdzas so sor phul bas yam shing gis gzi brjid dang / mar gyis tshe 'phel zhing / til gyis nad dang bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang / zas mchog gis phun sum tshogs pa 'phel ba dang / 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams kyis longs spyod dang dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang / dur was tshe 'phel ba dang / ku shas bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub gnang bar bsam zhing / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rdzas kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ til la bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis stong la sogs 'bul lo/ /gal te rbod gtong dang / byad stims la sogs yod kyis dgos na/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li nas/

mo ha ya'i bar brjod pa'i mthar/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong dang / byad stems thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs dbul lo/ /bar skabs su me gso ba'i phyir/ bud shing bsnan zhing / yam shing dang mar yang ci rigs dbul lo/ /de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba rdzogs pa'i mthar gshegs skyems byon zan bzhin mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gong bzhin skabs su gang babs gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li/ ba da li/ ba ra li/ ba ra ha mu khi/ sarba duṣṭa/ pra duṣṭa nāṃ tsakṣurmu khaṃ/ bandha bandha/ bandha mu khaṃ/ dzambha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ grihṇā pa ya/ grihṇā pa ya swāhā/ zhes sngags bdun gyis phul nas/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ gdan sa nas/ 'gal rkyen bar chad gong bzhin/ sdig pa dang / nad dang / gdon dang / phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa ltar gnang bar bsam mo/ /de nas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

/zhes dang yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ thal ba cung zad rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar bskus nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim/ zhes brjod/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha sngar bzhin gsal bar gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdun bdun nam nyi shu rtsa re sngar ltar phul la/ byon zan gyis skabs ltar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ agna ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya/ ma ma sarba pa paṃ sarba bighnān/ sarba u pa dra bya shīntaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas/ gdan sa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ bar gong bzhin/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs shlau ka gcig spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las phyir bskyed de/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /slar yang dus bzhin ci nas byon/ /bdag gi las rnams thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ de nas las kyi rjes bsdus te/ thal ba rol mo dang bcas pas chu bo chen por dor la/ dga' ston la longs spyod cing / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'od zer can ma 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs bsngo smon bkra shis tshigs bcad brjod/ gal te gzhan gyi don du byed par 'dod na bsgrub bya de nyid la dmigs shing ming du spel te bsreg blugs phul bas de'i don du 'gyur ba nyid do/ /sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim nas dngos grub rab tu ster/ /gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni gang /
